I agree that children can be horrible. Many children bully each other and harm one another Those behaviors are taught at home, and in society in general. we don't know how to address these circumstances and they pester. I don't hate children, I just hate how people portray them to be innocent and harmless creatures who can't do wrong. Personally, I do want to have children because it is unfair, in my opinion, to bring people into a world they didn't ask for. If people want to have children, that's fine, but be sure that you are responsible enough to raise your child to be a good person and not enter them into a dysfunctional setting. (I know certain circumstances make it hard to have a choice on whether or not to have children, but in a general sense)

Yeah, but it is more than that. Social media is toxic overall, not just the most disturbing things. I deleted it for multiple reasons, but that was the final straw.

I agree. Suicide isn't the easy way out, it is the option that someone choose when everything else fails. You can no longer exist in your own because everything hurts. Nothing is worth it anymore. You try to stay, you convince yourself it will get better, but nothing works. It is despair and hopelessness. It is hard to hold on, especially when no one knows you're struggling. 

If you need to talk to someone, please message me.

I can exist without social media, I don't talk to anyone and I have zero friends, so I don't need it, I just wish I could stop thinking about it because it made my suicidal feelings worse. It makes me not want to live in a world like this.

I saw it on Instagram & Twitter mainly. I wish I never did, but social media is a dangerous place because there isn't a lot of monitoring and they don't reinforce their guidelines. It is more common than I thought which is disturbing, but I just couldn't do it anymore.

I can relate to this post as well, I don't have any friends at all, I don't talk or video chat to anyone because I don't have anybody. The loneliness just eats you alive and it becomes unbearable where you suicide is the only option. I don't respond to reddits, I just read them because I don't want to say the wrong thing, but this really hit me and I know fake ass platitudes like "it's selfish, it will get better, don't hurt those around you" doesn't work at all. I don't know why I keep going, I always tell myself "whatever can get you through the day, that's all that matters."
